title: Session part types define incompatible shapes for the same API object
reasoning: The project has two exported `Part` interfaces with overlapping domain meaning but different contracts. `app/types/part.ts` allows `ru`, `hy_east`, and `hy_west` to be null and includes fields such as `duration_type`, `page`, `posture`, `sheet_music`, and `assignment`; `app/types/session.ts` makes the same language fields required strings and omits those additional fields. Code typed against the session-local `Part` can therefore treat nullable API fields as always present or silently lose required properties when shared across session/parts flows.
recommendation: Keep one canonical `Part` interface and import it wherever needed, or explicitly name the session-specific reduced type and derive it with `Pick`/`Omit` so nullability and omitted fields are intentional.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included auth integration test only exercises login/logout state and does not instantiate or validate session part payload shapes.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a type-level or runtime fixture test for a session/parts response containing null language fields and the full part metadata, ensuring all consuming types accept the same backend shape.
